subject: 航空器構造與原理 - 構造、認證與空氣動力學基礎

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於航空器適航證書（Airworthiness Certificate）的分類與特徵，下列敘述何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 標準適航證書為粉紅色，適用於實驗航空器
(B) 特種適航證書為白色，適用於運輸類航空器
(C) 標準適航證書為白色，適用於通用、特技及運輸類航空器
(D) 輕型運動航空器（LSA）核發的是標準適航證書
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding the classification and characteristics of Airworthiness Certificates, which of the following statements is correct?
en_options: (A) Standard Airworthiness Certificates are pink and apply to experimental aircraft
(B) Special Airworthiness Certificates are white and apply to transport category aircraft
(C) Standard Airworthiness Certificates are white and apply to Normal, Aerobatic, and Transport categories
(D) Light Sport Aircraft (LSA) are issued Standard Airworthiness Certificates
mc_questions.explanation: 根據法規，Standard Airworthiness Certificate 為白色，適用於 Normal, Utility, Aerobatic, Commuter, Transport 等類別；而 Special Airworthiness Certificate 為粉紅色（Pink），適用於 LSA、Experimental 或 Restricted 等類別。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於全動式水平尾翼（Stabilator）及其配平裝置的運作邏輯，下列敘述何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 反伺服片（Anti-servo tab）的移動方向與全動式水平尾翼後緣相反
(B) 反伺服片的主要目的是增加控制靈敏度，使飛行員更容易拉起機頭
(C) 當飛行員向後拉駕駛桿時，全動式水平尾翼後緣向上移動，反伺服片也向上移動
(D) 全動式水平尾翼不具備配平（Trim）功能，須完全由飛行員體力維持位置
mc_questions.en_question: Concerning the operation logic of a Stabilator and its trimming device, which statement is correct?
en_options: (A) The anti-servo tab moves in the opposite direction to the trailing edge of the stabilator
(B) The primary purpose of the anti-servo tab is to increase control sensitivity
(C) When the pilot pulls back on the control wheel, the trailing edge of the stabilator moves up, and the anti-servo tab also moves up
(D) A stabilator does not have a trim function and requires the pilot to maintain position manually
mc_questions.explanation: Stabilator 使用 Anti-servo tab，其移動方向與後緣「相同」。當後緣向上時，片子也向上，產生的空氣阻力會試圖將尾翼推回原位，藉此降低過高的靈敏度（Less sensitive）並提供人工感覺，同時它也兼具 Trim tab 的功能。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在飛機結構設計中，關於「半懸臂式」（Semi-cantilever）機翼與「全懸臂式」（Full cantilever）機翼的差異，下列何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 半懸臂式機翼完全依靠內部結構支撐，不需外部支柱
(B) 全懸臂式機翼通常見於高原型飛機，需要張線支撐
(C) 半懸臂式機翼利用外部支柱（Struts）將飛行酬載傳遞至機身結構
(D) 現代多數低單翼飛機為了增加強度，皆採用半懸臂式設計
mc_questions.en_question: In aircraft structural design, what is the correct distinction between semi-cantilever and full cantilever wings?
en_options: (A) Semi-cantilever wings rely entirely on internal structures without external supports
(B) Full cantilever wings are commonly found on high-wing aircraft and require bracing wires
(C) Semi-cantilever wings use external struts to transmit flight loads to the fuselage structure
(D) Most modern low-wing aircraft use semi-cantilever designs to increase strength
mc_questions.explanation: Semi-cantilever 意指機翼具備外部支柱（Struts）輔助支撐酬載；而 Full cantilever 則是所有應力皆由機翼內部結構（如 Spars）承擔，外表無支柱。

mc_questions.zh_question: 螺旋槳產生推力的主要物理原理為何？
zh_options: (A) 透過增加發動機排氣速度產生反作用力
(B) 螺旋槳葉片撥動空氣向後，產生機械摩擦力
(C) 螺旋槳葉片在前方產生低壓區，後方產生高壓區，形成壓力差
(D) 透過調整螺旋槳螺距（Pitch）直接推動機身
mc_questions.en_question: What is the primary physical principle by which a propeller generates thrust?
en_options: (A) By increasing engine exhaust velocity to create reaction force
(B) By mechanical friction created as the blades push air backwards
(C) By creating a low-pressure area in front and a high-pressure area behind the blades, forming a pressure differential
(D) By adjusting the propeller pitch to directly push the airframe
mc_questions.explanation: 螺旋槳本質上是一個旋轉的機翼（airfoil），其旋轉時在葉片前方形成低壓、後方形成高壓。這種壓力差產生的合力即為推力。發動機提供扭矩，而螺旋槳將其轉化為氣動力。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於半硬殼式結構（Semi-monocoque）與硬殼式結構（Monocoque）的主要差異，下列敘述何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 半硬殼式完全依靠蒙皮（Skin）承受所有飛行荷重
(B) 硬殼式結構內部有密集的縱樑（Longerons）與斜撐
(C) 半硬殼式結構利用內部骨架（如 Stringers, Formers）加強蒙皮，共同承擔應力
(D) 硬殼式結構因重量輕、抗損性高，是現代客機的首選
mc_questions.en_question: What is the main difference between semi-monocoque and monocoque structures?
en_options: (A) Semi-monocoque relies entirely on the skin to support all flight loads
(B) Monocoque structures have dense internal longerons and struts
(C) Semi-monocoque structures use an internal framework (such as stringers and formers) to reinforce the skin and share the stress
(D) Monocoque is the preferred choice for modern airliners due to its light weight and high damage tolerance
mc_questions.explanation: Monocoque（硬殼式）主要靠應力蒙皮支撐荷重，類似鋁罐。而 Semi-monocoque（半硬殼式）則在蒙皮內部增加了 Bulkheads（隔框）、Formers（成形框）和 Stringers（縱樑）等次結構，能有效防止蒙皮因受壓而皺縮，是目前飛機結構的主流。

mc_questions.zh_question: 飛機煞車系統中，碳纖維（Carbon）煞車盤相較於鋼製（Steel）煞車盤的主要優勢是什麼？
zh_options: (A) 成本較低且易於保養
(B) 重量更輕且能吸收更多的熱能（Energy）
(C) 在低溫環境下的磨合性能較好
(D) 使用壽命是依據行駛里程而非著陸次數計算
mc_questions.en_question: What is the primary advantage of carbon brakes over steel brakes in aircraft braking systems?
en_options: (A) Lower cost and easier maintenance
(B) Lighter weight and ability to absorb more energy
(C) Better friction performance in low-temperature environments
(D) Service life is measured in miles rather than landings
mc_questions.explanation: 碳纖維煞車系統重量較輕，且熱容量大，能承受落地時產生的高溫。此外，音訊提到飛機煞車的壽命是以著陸次數（Landings）而非里程數計算。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在複合材料飛機上,關於閃電防護(Lightning Strike Protection)的敘述,下列何者正確?
zh_options: (A) 碳纖維(Carbon fiber)本身是完美的絕緣體,不需要額外避雷設施
(B) 玻纖(Fiberglass)與碳纖維皆必須在表層黏貼金屬網(Mesh)以導電
(C) 碳纖維結構通常使用鋁網(Aluminum mesh)來進行防護
(D) 避雷網修復時,只需要更換外層漆面,不需要確保與底層結構的電連續性
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding lightning strike protection on composite aircraft, which of the following statements is correct?
en_options: (A) Carbon fiber is a perfect insulator and requires no additional protection.
(B) Both fiberglass and carbon fiber must have metal meshes bonded to the skin surface.
(C) Carbon fiber structures typically use aluminum mesh for protection.
(D) During lightning mesh repair, only the topcoat needs replacement without ensuring electrical continuity.
mc_questions.explanation: 由於玻纖是絕緣體而碳纖維導電性不如鋁材,故皆需加裝金屬網(Metal Mesh)來提供路徑導走強大電流。根據系統邏輯,玻纖常用鋁網,碳纖維則常用銅網(Copper Mesh)以防止電化學腐蝕。

mc_questions.zh_question: 根據儀表分類邏輯,下列哪一項屬於「控制儀表」(Control Instruments)?
zh_options: (A) 垂直速率表 (VSI)
(B) 高度計 (Altimeter)
(C) 姿態儀 (Attitude Indicator)
(D) 空速表 (Airspeed Indicator)
mc_questions.en_question: According to the instrument classification logic, which of the following is a 'Control Instrument'?
en_options: (A) Vertical Speed Indicator (VSI)
(B) Altimeter
(C) Attitude Indicator
(D) Airspeed Indicator
mc_questions.explanation: 控制儀表(Control Instruments)顯示的是即時的姿態(Attitude)或動力(Power)變化;而空速、高度、VSI 等顯示的是這些變化後產生的結果,被歸類為表現儀表(Performance Instruments)。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於全球定位系統(GPS)的運作,若要計算出包含高度的「三維位置」(3D Position),至少需要鎖定幾顆衛星的訊號?
zh_options: (A) 2 顆
(B) 3 顆
(C) 4 顆
mc_questions.en_question: To calculate a 3D position (including altitude) using GPS, the receiver must be locked onto the signal of at least how many satellites?
en_options: (A) 2 satellites
(B) 3 satellites
(C) 4 satellites
(D) 24 satellites
mc_questions.explanation: 3 顆衛星可計算緯度與經度(2D),若要精確得知第三維度「高度」(Altitude),則至少需要 4 顆衛星。多出的衛星則可用於抵銷訊號誤差。

cloze_items.cloze_text: An airplane is defined as an engine-driven, fixed-wing aircraft that is supported in flight by the {{c1::dynamic reaction}} of air against its wings.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 飛機被定義為一種由引擎驅動、固定翼的航空器，在飛行中依靠空氣對其機翼的「動態反應」來支撐。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是飛機產升力的基本物理定義，區別於浮力（氣球）或旋轉翼（直升機）。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Standard airworthiness certificates are {{c1::white}} and are issued for normal, utility, aerobatic, commuter, or transport category aircraft.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 標準適航證書為「白色」，發給正常類、實用類、特技類、通勤類或運輸類航空器。
cloze_items.explanation: 適航證書的顏色是檢查員判別航空器認證類別的首要依據。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The longitudinal, lateral, and vertical axes of an aircraft all pass through the {{c1::center of gravity}} (CG).
cloze_items.zh_translation: 航空器的縱軸、橫軸和垂直軸都通過其「重心」（CG）。
cloze_items.explanation: 飛機的所有姿態旋轉運動（Roll, Pitch, Yaw）在物理上都是圍繞重心發生的。

cloze_items.cloze_text: When the ailerons move to roll the aircraft, they move in {{c1::opposite}} directions to create asymmetrical lift.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 當副翼移動以使飛機滾轉時，它們會向「相反」的方向移動以產生不對稱升力。
cloze_items.explanation: 一側向上減小升力，另一側向下增加升力，產生滾轉力矩。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Unlike ailerons, flaps move {{c1::simultaneously}} downward to increase lift for takeoffs and landings.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 與副翼不同，襟翼會「同時」向下移動，以增加起飛和降落時的升力。
cloze_items.explanation: 襟翼是高升力裝置，兩側同步移動以保持橫向平衡。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The principal structural members of the wing are the {{c1::spars}}, ribs, and stringers.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 機翼主要的結構構件是「翼樑」（Spars）、翼肋和縱樑。
cloze_items.explanation: 翼樑是承擔主要飛行負荷（特別是彎曲負荷）的最核心部件。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The anti-servo tab moves in the {{c1::same}} direction as the trailing edge of the stabilator.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 反伺服片的移動方向與全動式水平尾翼的後端緣「相同」。
cloze_items.explanation: 這種設計提供了控制反饋力，避免全動式尾翼因過於靈敏而導致飛行員過度操作。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Propellers produce thrust by creating a {{c1::low-pressure}} area at the front of the propeller's airfoil.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 螺旋槳透過在其葉片剖面（翼型）前方產生「低壓」區來製造推力。
cloze_items.explanation: 螺旋槳本質上是旋轉的機翼，利用伯努利原理產生向前的拉力。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The primary function of an aircraft electrical system is to generate, regulate, and distribute electrical power, often using engine-driven {{c1::AC generators}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 飛機電氣系統的主要功能是產生、調節和分配電力，通常使用由發動機帶動的交流發電機。
cloze_items.explanation: 現代飛機主要電力來源包括交流發電機（AC Generators）、APU 以及外部電源。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The Angle of Attack (AOA) is defined as the angle between the relative wind and the {{c1::chord line}} of the propeller blade.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 攻角（AOA）被定義為相對風與螺旋槳葉片翼弦線之間的夾角。
cloze_items.explanation: AOA 是決定螺旋槳效率的關鍵因素，在飛行過程中會隨飛機動態持續變化。

cloze_items.cloze_text: In a truss structure, lengths of tubing called {{c1::longerons}} are welded in place to form a well-braced framework.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 在桁架式結構中，稱為「縱樑」的管材被焊接定位，以形成堅固的支撐框架。
cloze_items.explanation: 桁架式結構（Truss）主要由 Longerons（縱樑）和 Struts（斜撐）組成，早期飛機多用此結構。

cloze_items.cloze_text: A major disadvantage of composite structures is the lack of visual proof of damage, such as hidden {{c1::delamination}} after an impact.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 複合材料結構的一個主要缺點是缺乏損傷的視覺證據，例如撞擊後產生的隱藏性「層間剝離」。
cloze_items.explanation: 複合材料受損後表面可能完好，但內部結構可能已產生 delamination（脫層），必須由專業人員檢測。

cloze_items.cloze_text: In composite materials, the {{c1::matrix}} is the glue used to hold the fibers together and gives the part its shape.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 在複合材料中，「基材（Matrix）」是用來將纖維黏合在一起並賦予零件形狀的膠體。
cloze_items.explanation: 基材（通常為 Epoxy resin，環氧樹脂）負責固定纖維位置，而纖維則負責承受荷重。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Because airplane brakes must absorb enormous amounts of energy during landing, their life is measured in {{c1::landings}} rather than miles.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 由於飛機煞車必須在著陸時吸收巨大能量，其壽命是以「著陸次數」而非里程數來衡量的。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是航空器維修中非常重要的計量觀念，反映了煞車系統承受的熱循環損耗。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Aluminum and copper mesh are the two most common types, with aluminum used on fiberglass and {{c1::copper}} on carbon fiber.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 鋁網與銅網是兩種最常見的類型,鋁網用於玻璃纖維,而銅網則用於碳纖維。
cloze_items.explanation: 碳纖維結構若直接接觸鋁網會產生電化學腐蝕,故在系統設計上優先選用銅網。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Any structural repairs on lightning strike protected areas must also include the {{c1::mesh}} as well as the underlying structure.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 任何在避雷保護區域的結構維修,除了底層結構外,也必須包含金屬避雷網的修復。
cloze_items.explanation: 若維修忽略了 Mesh 的電連續性,將導致結構在下次雷擊時無法有效排流而受損。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Internal radio antennas require {{c1::windows}} in the lightning strike mesh to allow radio frequencies to pass through.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 機身內部的無線電天線需要在避雷網上保留「窗口」,以便讓無線電頻率穿透。
cloze_items.explanation: 金屬避雷網會阻擋電磁波,因此天線安裝位置必須特別設計避雷網的空隙(Windows)。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The first screen installed in front of the pilot position is referred to as the {{c1::Primary Flight Display (PFD)}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 安裝在機師正前方的第一個儀表螢幕被稱為主飛行顯示器(PFD)。
cloze_items.explanation: PFD 整合了傳統的六大儀表功能,是機師獲取飛行數據的主要來源。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Performance instruments indicate the aircraft's {{c1::actual performance}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 表現儀表指示的是飛機的實際表現(結果)。
cloze_items.explanation: 例如空速表、高度計、VSI 等都屬於反映飛機目前運行結果的表現儀表。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Control instruments display immediate {{c1::attitude}} and power changes.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 控制儀表顯示的是即時的姿態與動力變化。
cloze_items.explanation: 這類儀表讓機師知道自己對控制裝置施加影響後,飛機當下的即時反應。
